release_notes: Report numbers match Keitaro again: a click is every visit to the campaign link (unique clicks are a subset of it), the offer funnel keeps its own Offer clicks / LP clicks metrics with a new Offer clicks card and chart line on the dashboard, and EPC/CPC divide by clicks. The dashboard chart is built from the same query as the cards: real cost, profit and ROI instead of a hardcoded zero, only the metrics you picked, and a correct This-year view. Cloaking streams get a customizable preloader for the JS browser check (#18): the built-in page or your own HTML with a live preview, per stream, independent of the Safe Page. The in-panel updater again reports success after a good update (v1.8.4 showed a generic error while the update actually installed). No migration; suite 144/144.
